done_when: src/forge/templates/skill.md (synced to every repo for Claude Code and Codex) says: when the human states a new direction, principle or value, first grill it before changing anything: ask one question at a time with a recommended answer, looking up facts in the repo instead of asking, until the plan for applying it is agreed; then make the changes; a test pins the rule in the synced skill
why: When the owner states a new direction or value (for example 'Forge should favour end-to-end tests'), the coordinator turns it straight into changes without first working out how it applies, so plans miss the questions that matter
